body:
1\. Release check cannot write the plan output 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
The release workflow applies --cap-drop ALL to the toolkit’s root-run plan command, removing
CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE while /out points to a runner-owned directory. When $RUNNER_TEMP/plan has
mode 0755, plan cannot write its output files and the images job stops before publishing, unlike
the corresponding plan step in bench.yml.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The release images job drops all capabilities from the toolkit’s root-run `plan` container. It then cannot write its output files into the runner-owned `$RUNNER_TEMP/plan` bind mount when that directory has mode 0755, stopping the job before publishing. ## Fix Focus Areas - .github/workflows/release.yml[209-218] ## Recommended Fix Keep the sandbox restrictions, but give the container write access to the output directory without restoring unnecessary capabilities. Add `--user "$(id -u):$(id -g)"` to the plan `docker run` or the shared `sandbox` array; alternatively, make `$RUNNER_TEMP/plan` writable before the run, for example with `chmod 0777`. Verify that plan creates both output files and that the release plan step still behaves like its counterpart in bench.yml. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
